description: Read ETH balance snapshots and selected ERC-20-shaped Transfer events for one wallet in a completed bounded finalized page. Save the owned cursor and use a new paid operation for the next page. Not full native/internal/NFT/transaction history; provider-reported logs cannot prove completeness. $0.020000 native USDC/call on Base (eip155:8453); compatible x402 or enabled native MPP client required, no Fresh402 token for first purchase. Save proof/input and private recovery token BEFORE paying for full-response-loss protection: REST X-Fresh402-Recovery-Token; MCP params._meta['fresh402/recovery-token']. Recover originals without new RPC/debit; foreign snapshot/cursor forbidden. Provider failure/partial scan is not paid success. observation_saved=false/persistence_error: recover only, never use unsaved IDs. Prepaid needs eligible finalized all-service credits or an original explicit service-specific tariff4 grant; inspect /v3/prepaid/quote/wallet_watch and /v3/prepaid/all-services. Historical Web rights unchanged; paying agents do not need their own RPC credentials. Observations30days, private financial recovery7days. Not full history, financial advice or security audit. Clients: https://fresh402.com/docs#payments. Free signed trial: /v3/agent-trial requires an unfunded EOA ownership signature; human Web trial: /v2/trial. Eligibility/capacity may return429. Use only X-Fresh402-Trial-Key plus persisted Idempotency-Key; replay exact tool/input/key. Exhaustion never authorizes a charge.

address.description: 20-byte Ethereum address; lowercase/uppercase accepted, mixed case must have a valid EIP-55 checksum. Normalized to checksummed form.

block.description: Finalized only. Every state read pins the selected block hash with requireCanonical:true; no latest/number fallback.

chain_id.description: Base mainnet only; returned provider chain must match.

chunk_size.description: Single bounded chunk; four-block maximum and no automatic retry.

cursor.description: Owned opaque cursor from a prior successful wallet_watch. Scope, wallet, tokens, provider and policy must match.

from_block.description: Initial first block; cannot be supplied with cursor. Default last four finalized blocks; a gap beyond32 fails without skipping history.

max_blocks.description: At most four blocks in this paid page; default4. has_more describes a completed bounded page, not permission to charge a failed partial scan.

tokens.description: One to four selected ERC-20 contracts; no full wallet transaction history.

items.description: 20-byte Ethereum address; lowercase/uppercase accepted, mixed case must have a valid EIP-55 checksum. Normalized to checksummed form.

name: fresh402_wallet_watch
